objective: Extend novelty research and select a coherent game design while preserving unusual mechanics.
tracks: A: authored tactics plus manual execution
B: causal rhetoric plus unusual interactions
accounting_scope: Only this design dialogue; parent tools and earlier experiments excluded.

role_receipts.proposer_claim: A complete shared-rule run; public commitments may make rhetoric causal.
role_receipts.evidence_or_assumption: Confirmed user constraints plus design assumptions; primary precedent information supplied by parent.
role_receipts.reconciliation: Revise minimality claim; define observation/actions/hazards/costs; narrow B to one goal-dependent operation.

role_receipts.proposer_claim: Goal-dependent touch/wound/arrival outcomes differ; finite resources and ordered resolution close costs.
role_receipts.evidence_or_assumption: Confirmed user constraints plus design assumptions; primary precedent information supplied by parent.
role_receipts.reconciliation: Specify reject/replace/expire commands, explicit alternate/stop authority, token cancellation/refunds, direct-damage endpoints and feasible responses.

role_receipts.proposer_claim: Explicit command/token lifecycle and worked goal pairs close the selected specification.
role_receipts.evidence_or_assumption: Transparent illustrative utility and constructed states; no gameplay experiment.
balancer_objections: illustrative utility is not player preference
role_receipts.reconciliation: Accept specification closure; keep unknown game efficacy, learned creativity and global novelty; retain F1–F3 as genuine tensions.

selected_unit: One complete three-stage expedition; three hero choices with one deployed; manual and authored auto; bounded items/XP; reflect/maze/mobile-magic build pressures; one public-goal-dependent reward operator.

technique_trace.trigger_summary: Broad game idea crosses purpose, capability, workflow and rule levels.
technique_trace.inspected_state: Purpose: adaptive survival; capability: compose/execute a build; workflow: full run; policy/interface: controller, effect and token contracts.
technique_trace.emitted_output: Accept user-fit full-run unit; do not call a value or effect list a complete game.
technique_trace.readiness_effect: Design level assignments are explicit; gameplay remains unverified.

technique_trace.trigger_summary: Smallest unit must reconstruct the requested expedition.
technique_trace.inspected_state: Named public snapshots, commands, encounter warnings, tokens, effects and progression choices.
technique_trace.emitted_output: Keep a complete three-stage unit; split sound as a bounded input extension.
technique_trace.readiness_effect: Specification has named coordination; implementation is not proved.

technique_trace.trigger_summary: User explicitly wants later counter-levels, skill effects and wild audio variants.
technique_trace.inspected_state: Variation in encounters, policies, item interactions and input channels.
technique_trace.emitted_output: Preserve content/effect/input boundaries; defer campaign, multiplayer and unrestricted programming.
technique_trace.readiness_effect: Concrete variation is accommodated at a proportionate design boundary.

technique_trace.trigger_summary: Optimization may fail after player evidence or changed requirements.
technique_trace.inspected_state: Expiry triggers: poor input feel, unexpressible recovery, equivalent commitment behavior, changed deployment/run/audio requirement.
technique_trace.emitted_output: Rerun the bounded design at a concrete trigger; do not declare universal optimality.

technique_trace.trigger_summary: Six rules, routes, commitments, upgrades and possible sound increase coordination.
technique_trace.inspected_state: One bindable token, six authored rules, fired-rule explanation, staged introduction.
technique_trace.emitted_output: Retain a paper authoring/priority-conflict probe; usability unknown.
technique_trace.readiness_effect: Bounded candidate; comprehension must be measured.

technique_trace.trigger_summary: Known melee/ranged/terrain/poison/path-counter variation meets bounded policies.
technique_trace.inspected_state: Deliberate risk, explicit alternates, reserve thresholds, fallback and three hero vocabularies.
technique_trace.emitted_output: Select full run with distinct pressures; validate against competent generic behavior on varied encounters.
technique_trace.readiness_effect: Fit is plausible; viable policies and balance unknown.

technique_trace.trigger_summary: Manual player, auto controller, designer and future implementer can interpret goals differently.
technique_trace.inspected_state: Stable accepted-hit touch, direct-damage wound, arrival predicate, identical action/resource contracts.
technique_trace.emitted_output: Keep shared meanings; permit different command sources and input strengths.
technique_trace.readiness_effect: Semantic interfaces are explicit; no equal-difficulty claim.

technique_trace.trigger_summary: New mechanic and usefulness claims coexist with known game precedents.
technique_trace.inspected_state: Nine references/sixteen primary game descriptions; proposed effects and worked utility models.
technique_trace.emitted_output: Classify literature/precedents as scoped knowledge, game advantage and global novelty as unknown.
technique_trace.readiness_effect: Prevents prepared concepts becoming efficacy claims.

technique_trace.trigger_summary: Deep requires premortem; editor load and conventional reward equivalence threaten identity.
technique_trace.inspected_state: Failure scenario: long authoring session over an ordinary survival loop; exposure build dominates.
technique_trace.emitted_output: Use competent controls, priority repair exercise, limited token count, source attribution and bounded rewards.
technique_trace.readiness_effect: Manageable design risks remain empirical questions.

technique_trace.trigger_summary: Deep permits but does not require a formal tournament.
technique_trace.inspected_state: Two tracks are complementary candidates with actual critique, not scored tournament arms.
technique_trace.emitted_output: Select A plus one B operation; retain alternatives without inventing tournament scores.
technique_trace.readiness_effect: No ranking or measured winner is claimed.

technique_trace.trigger_summary: Dense research package needs a usable continuation.
technique_trace.inspected_state: Research report → game design → portfolio/strategies → precedents/sources → trace/validation.
technique_trace.emitted_output: Provide reading path, decisions, deferred mechanisms, unknowns and next prototype route.
technique_trace.readiness_effect: Artifacts are reviewable without reconstructing chat history.

stable_tensions: F1: A conventional conditional reward keyed to the displayed objective can reproduce the operator; distinctiveness is only against named controls.
F2: Shield/stamina utility is illustrative and can reverse across player states.
F3: Six-rule expressibility does not establish priority comprehension or usability.

cycle_guard.action: Stop recursion and save current candidate plus residue; no fourth round.

robot_talks.reason: Actual role dialogue is Distill. Canonical Robot Talks applicability/entry requirements were not claimed satisfied; possible later cross-layer route.

next_route: invoke design / scoped prototype project; targeted input, authoring and goal-pair probes remain unrun.
navigation_closeout_status: prepared; local link validation recorded separately.

subagent_execution_closeout.meaning: Final R3 responses were received from both agents; no scheduled role turn remains. Agent handles may remain available for explicit follow-up.
